caption: The drawing features a wooden cabinet with a curved front and a polished brown finish. The upper section contains four rectangular drawers arranged in two rows, each drawer having a decorative circular brass handle with a floral backplate. Below the drawers, the main body of the cabinet consists of a vertically ribbed door section, which extends across the curved front and is divided by a narrow vertical line indicating the separation of the doors. The doors have a small round brass knob on the right side. The cabinet stands on four turned legs, each ending in a brass cap. The overall composition highlights the wood grain with additional thin gold-colored border accents, and the background is plain beige.
title: Washstand
